message.content: CAIR Action listed Barrera as preferred for the California Superintendent of Public Instruction general election, while the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorsed him. At a state-superintendent forum, Barrera expressed concerns about AB 715's classroom effects and declined to commit to defending the bill against every lawsuit, stating he would defend it when that protects students. His opponent Sonja Shaw, rated opposed by Vote for Peace, pressed for stronger AB 715 enforcement at the same forum, discussed antisemitism in the Israel-Gaza context on Fox News in December 2023, and in March 2024 refused to let a pro-Palestinian group speak at a Chino Valley school board meeting. The California Teachers Association independent-expenditure committee spent over six million dollars in independent spending supporting Barrera and over half a million opposing Shaw.
